claims.citation: Lloyd's List, 22 August 1866, p. 3, col. 4 (British Newspaper Archive)
New York Herald, 31 July 1866, p. 9, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Borussia (Ham), Schwensen, Hamburg, 15th
and Southampton 18th inst, with mdse and 541 passengers,
to Kunhardt & Co. 18th inst, off Start Point, passed
ship Star of Peace (Am), from London for Mauritius; off
Landsend, steamship Bavaria, hence for Hamburg; 19th, lat
49 34, lon 12 21, ship Buffalo, from Quebec, bound E; 22d,
lat 49 37, lon 29 30, steamship City of London, hence for Liv-
erpool; 25th, lat 46 30[?], lon 50 34, bark Celeste Clark, from
Gottenburg for New York; 28th, lat 41 03[?], lon 65 35, ship
Lewis, and bark Argonaut, both bound W.
